About.title: About
About.heading: About Spexflix
About.description: Spexflix is provided by FGV and collects the recordings of the spex over the years.
About.feedbackDescription: We value your opinion. Do you have suggestions for improvements or have you found a bug? Get in touch at {email}.

Support.title: Support
Support.heading: How can we help?
Support.description: Found a technical problem, or trouble logging in or with watching? We are happy to help.
Support.contactDescription: Describe your problem as clearly as possible. Get in touch at {email}.

Home.title: Spexflix
Home.mustBeLoggedIn: Log in with your FGV account to watch.
Home.intro: The recordings of the spex through the years: full shows, numbers, trailers and material from behind the scenes.

Search.title: Search
Search.hint: Search titles, spex, descriptions, performances and chapters. At least two characters.

Manage.newVideoText: Pick the spex the video belongs to. Title and year come from the spex unless you give others. Then upload the file; the video is unpublished until you publish it.
Manage.title: Title
Manage.spexSearch: Search spex by title or year
Manage.spexHint: Leave empty for a video not about one spex, e.g. a jubilee.
Manage.fileQueued: The file is waiting to be processed
Manage.fileText: Any video format ffmpeg reads will do. Large files are uploaded in parts and survive interruptions. Spexflix always makes its own quality levels; an H.264/AAC file is processed fastest.
Manage.publishText: Published videos are visible to everyone.
Manage.publishWhenReady: The video can be published when it is processed.
Manage.chaptersText: Mark where the numbers start, and link them to the tracks in Spexify.
Manage.chaptersNoTracks: Mark where the numbers start. Spexify has no tracks for this spex, so the chapters are not linked there.
Manage.chapterInvalid: Every chapter needs a start time (m:ss) and a title.
Manage.label: Name
Manage.trashVideo: Move the video to the trash
Manage.trashVideoText: The video is hidden everywhere except the trash, and can be restored from there.

Trash.title: Trash
Trash.text: Videos in the trash are hidden from everyone. Restore them here; an admin can delete them for good.
Trash.textAdmin: Videos in the trash are hidden from everyone. Deleting removes the files for good.
Trash.confirmDelete: Delete {title} and its files for good?
Trash.confirmEmpty: Delete everything in the trash and its files for good?
